reason: It's free for the month and the read-only Instagram connect means I'm not filling forms, so I'd sign up and see if the matches beat what my four WhatsApp groups already throw at me. The comment-to-DM thing is the bit I actually want, because more people DMing me off a reel is reach, and reach is what I'm after right now.
objection: Influish costs the same and already has lakhs of creators, and my WhatsApp groups give me barter leads for nothing. A small beta in Bengaluru only might just show me the same three cafés everyone is already pitching, and at 2K-10K followers I doubt brands will pick me over bigger accounts.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month I've got zero real collab offers or the auto-DM hasn't brought any new followers or engagement, I won't pay the ₹499; one actual paid or barter collab through it would lock me in.
